'''Dead Man's Turn''' was a 120° turn in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]], named so because of its hazardousness nature. Both [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] traversed it on [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] at some point in their lives. It was connected to [[Main Avenue]].
